definitions.gloss: firefly viewing; going out to enjoy or catch fireflies
definitions.explanation: The traditional summer pastime of going out on early-summer evenings to watch or catch fireflies near rivers and rice fields.

examples.japanese: {蛍狩|ほたるが}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{蛍狩|ほたるが}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: My family enjoyed firefly viewing together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初夏|しょか}→初夏：11740_shoka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧、⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧そば⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{蛍狩|ほたるが}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{楽|たの}しみ→楽しみ：01651_tanoshimi⟧だ。
examples.english: Going firefly viewing by the river on early-summer evenings is my yearly delight.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{蛍|ほたる}→蛍：02253_hotaru⟧ (firefly) + {狩|が}り (hunting, gathering); the second element voices to ⟦がり→ガリ：27408_gari⟧. Despite the word 'hunting', it usually means simply going out to enjoy the sight of fireflies. A seasonal early-summer (⟦{初夏|しょか}→初夏：11740_shoka⟧) activity.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蛍狩|ほたるが}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to go firefly viewing
- {蛍狩|ほたるが}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しむ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧: to enjoy firefly viewing

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{潮干狩|しおひが}り→潮干狩り：18507_shiohigari⟧: shellfish gathering — uses the same 〜{狩|が}り pattern for a seasonal outing
